semiconductor_relevance: High — TS Tech is directly involved in the manufacturing of diffusion furnaces, a critical component in semiconductor fabrication.
summary: TS Tech (Changzhou) Co., Ltd specializes in the production of diffusion furnaces used in semiconductor fabrication. With over 20 years of experience, the company focuses on R&D to differentiate its products and provides thermal technology services to equipment manufacturers.
capabilities: Thermal technology services for equipment manufacturers
